verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing documents automated retries of failed subscription and invoice payments (Smart Retries) as part of revenue recovery. It also mentions customer communications driven by Billing automations, and a PM confirmed card-update notice emails exist, though they are off by default. Only part of the dunning-sequence story is evidenced. missing for 10: branded dunning email configuration, in-app banners, configurable grace periods, final-state rules (cancel vs unpaid), independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can configure automated dunning sequences — branded emails, in-app banners, grace periods, and final-state rules like cancel vs unpaid

citations.quote: Smart Retries: Automatically retry failed payments to prevent involuntary churn due to temporary issues.
Stripe Billing can automatically retry failed subscription and invoice payments for you.
Automate many of your customer interactions by combining a customer portal with customer communications controlled by Stripe Billing automations.
Stripe Billing PM stated all customer emails (like credit card update notices) are off by default
